dcterms:description: The dataset for emotion recognition shared task consists of tweets where the emotion word was removed. It contains six different categories: anger, disgust, fear, joy, sadness, and surprise. The training dataset contains approximately 150,000 tweets and the test dataset contains more than 30,000 tweets.
dcterms:title: WASSA 2018 Emotion Recognition Dataset
